name: 327. Responses web_search keeps image_settings and web_search_call results (web search image fields)
description: Kimi's Responses web_search tool can run an image search: search_content_types includes image, image_settings sets max_results and caption, and with include web_search_call.results the web_search_call item carries a results array of image_result entries (https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/api/responses.md). The shared Responses schema (core/schemas/responses.go) lost both ends. ResponsesToolWebSearch had no image_settings field, so the tool reached the vendor without it. And a web_search_call's results were decoded by the embedded file-search struct into the file-search result type, so every entry came back as {} and the item gained a queries: null that the vendor never sent. image_settings is now carried as raw JSON, kept wherever search_content_types is kept; a web_search_call keeps its results as raw JSON and gets no queries field unless the vendor sent one. file_search_call is unchanged. Pinned in Go by TestResponsesWebSearchCallKeepsVendorResults, TestResponsesWebSearchToolKeepsImageSettings and the Moonshot provider tests; these cases pin the live wire on both Responses routes.

item.name: /v1/responses - image_settings reaches Kimi and web_search_call results come back whole - moonshot/kimi-k3.1-pro

exec: pm.test('web search image fields: 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + pm.response.text()).to.eql(200); });
var j = pm.response.json();
pm.test('web search image fields: image_settings on the request Kimi received', function () {
var rr = (j.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
var tool = (rr.tools || []).filter(function (t) { return t.type === 'web_search'; })[0];
pm.expect(tool, 'no web_search tool on the wire: ' + JSON.stringify(rr.tools)).to.exist;
pm.expect(tool.image_settings, 'image_settings dropped: ' + JSON.stringify(tool)).to.eql({ max_results: 2, caption: true });
pm.expect(tool.search_content_types, JSON.stringify(tool)).to.eql(['text', 'image']);
var calls = (j.output || []).filter(function (o) { return o.type === 'web_search_call'; });
pm.test('web search image fields: a web_search_call item came back', function () { pm.expect(calls.length, 'no web_search_call item: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('web search image fields: no queries field Kimi did not send', function () {
calls.forEach(function (c) { pm.expect(c, JSON.stringify(c).slice(0, 600)).to.not.have.property('queries'); });
pm.test('web search image fields: image results keep Kimi\'s fields, none emptied', function () {
var withResults = calls.filter(function (c) { return Array.isArray(c.results) && c.results.length > 0; });
pm.expect(withResults.length, 'no web_search_call carried results (include web_search_call.results, image search on): ' + JSON.stringify(calls).slice(0, 800)).to.be.above(0);
withResults.forEach(function (c) { c.results.forEach(function (r) {
pm.expect(r.type, JSON.stringify(r)).to.eql('image_result');
pm.expect(r.image_url, JSON.stringify(r)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;
